name: Murder at the Manor
description: A guest lies dead at the manor. Each suspect was in a different room with a different motive. Work out whodunit.
clues: Either Chef goes with Veranda or Grimsby goes with Veranda.
Grimsby does not go with Conservatory if and only if Governess does not go with Crane.
Between Crane and Pierce, one goes with Study and the other with Veranda.

hints.text: Suppose Crane went with Conservatory — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Crane goes with Conservatory.
Crane goes with Conservatory, so it can't also go with Study.
Crane goes with Conservatory, so it can't also go with Veranda.
…but now the clue “Between Crane and Pierce, one goes with Study and the other with Veranda” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Crane does not go with Conservatory.

hints.text: Suppose Grimsby didn't go with Conservatory — that hits a contradiction, so it does.
chain: Start by assuming Grimsby does not go with Conservatory.
